site.title: El Galeón de Alcorcón · Traditional Spanish restaurant
site.description: An eating house in the heart of Alcorcón: traditional Spanish cooking, recipes handed down through generations and a seasonal menu. Book at {street}.

hero.title:
Traditional

Spanish cooking, the way it used to be
hero.intro: Dishes prepared with care, quality ingredients and recipes handed down from generation to generation.

about.label: About us
about.lead: In the heart of Alcorcón, our restaurant was born with a very clear mission:
about.quote: “To bring back time-honoured flavours and share them with those who value real cooking”

house.label: Our house
house.title: An eating house with soul
house.p1: We are a team with a passion for traditional Spanish food, committed to serving dishes prepared with care, quality ingredients and recipes handed down from generation to generation.
house.p2: Every stew, every tapa and every dessert we serve tells a story: the story of our roots, of our families, of the village homes where the smell of the stewpot filled every room.
house.p3: Here there is no rush and no artifice, just authentic cooking, the way it used to be, with respect for the produce and love for what we do.

kitchen.label: The kitchen
kitchen.title: In step with the seasons
kitchen.text: Our menu changes with the seasons, respecting what each one brings and choosing what is fresh and what is ours.

invite.text: We want every visit to be a journey back in time: a friendly, warm and delicious experience.
invite.title: Welcome to <nw>El Galeón de Alcorcón.</nw> <gold>Welcome home.</gold>
